stem: Which sentence best explains why children should visit as many parks as they can?

options.label: A
options.text: This program offers a fun way for children to discover and explore in Texas state parks. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: This is good news for Texas state parks because there are nearly 100 parks in the state. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Each park offers a unique experience for young explorers. (paragraph 3)

options.label: D
options.text: This journal is available at every state park. (paragraph 4)
